title: First Occurrence Index
body_html:
First Occurrence Index

Fix a Witt tower \(T'\) of target spaces and let \(\widetilde\pi\) be an irreducible genuine supercuspidal representation of \(\widetilde G\) occurring in the Weil representation. For each \(V'\in T'\), let \(\Theta_{V,V'}(\widetilde\pi)\) denote the maximal \(\widetilde\pi\)-isotypic quotient on the target side.

The first occurrence index of \(\widetilde\pi\) in \(T'\) is \[ m_{T'}(\widetilde\pi)= \min\{\dim_D V' : V'\in T',\ \Theta_{V,V'}(\widetilde\pi)\ne 0\}. \] At first occurrence the theta lift is supercuspidal. Above first occurrence it remains nonzero, but may no longer be supercuspidal.
